claims: Spain defeated Serbia 3-0 in an international friendly on March 27, 2026 at Estadio de la Cerámica.
Mikel Oyarzabal scored two first-half goals.
Substitute Víctor Muñoz scored a goal on his senior debut.
Spain featured a 4-2-3-1 with Rodri and Pedri.
Serbia struggled to generate offensive pressure, according to ESPN.
The match took place on Friday, March 27, 2026.
The venue was Estadio de la Cerámica, Villarreal, Spain.
The match was part of Spain's preparations for the 2026 World Cup.
Spain had an unbeaten qualifying campaign.
